Attached to e-Correspondence to Andrew Kaplan from PO Bob Shea is Mr. Myers’s letter of September 11, 2023, along with another document that he filed and served at the same time. This document is entitled “Medway Grid Project Layout Comparisons,” and it illustrates some of the points made in the letter.

Attached is suggestion and comment discussing the relative new technology that Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) represent to the DPU with two suggestions. One, that the DPU consider development of a tracking system to monitor events for determination of Root Cause and potential impact on similar systems installed in Massachusetts. And, two that when such determination is made, the DPU should require retrofit and action for BESS using that the involved technology in Massachusetts.
